name: Skyrim Mod
summary: Trigger effects for every weapon type.
description:
The following weapon types have trigger support:
- Hand To Hand
- One Handed Sword
- One Handed Dagger
- One Handed Axe
- One Handed Mace
- Two Handed Sword
- Two Handed Axe Mace
- Bow
- Staves (think this is wand)
- Magic (when you cast spell)
- Shield
- Torch
- Crossbow
